item.description:

item.title: Amalek Means Doubt: What Purim Asks of Us | Festival Shiurim
item.description:
Why does Purim ask us to wipe out Amalek, and what is Amalek today? Given on the eve of Purim 2022, the shiur sets Purim in the Persian exile, reads the Megillah as a clash between honour that must be grabbed and honour that grows when shared, and goes through the laws of the day: hearing the Megillah by day, mishloah manot that feeds the meal, and gifts to the poor first. It ends with the Malbim on doubt: Amalek and safek share a value, and we defeat both by looking up with firm commitment.
